name: fulcrum-shop-floor-server
description: Backend proxy server for the Fulcrum Shop Floor PWA (Impulse Precision Manufacturing). Holds the single Fulcrum Public API bearer token server-side, exposes a small REST API matching the PWA's api.js seam, and maintains local side-tables Fulcrum's API has no place for (operator badge mapping, run->equipment attribution, idempotency keys, local pause reasons).
